links.outcome: Expert Likert ratings of LLM answers to guideline questions across urological cancers
links.effect: Claude 45.9% optimal and 87% optimal/acceptable; Gemini and ChatGPT 68%-70% optimal/acceptable; rephrased prompts did not consistently outperform simple prompts.
links.quote: Gemini and ChatGPT showed lower optimal rates but acceptable performance (68%-70% optimal/acceptable).

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of LLM outputs versus guideline-based reference
links.effect: Claude achieved 87% optimal/acceptable responses; Gemini and ChatGPT 68%-70%, so a substantial share of responses were not acceptable.
links.quote: Claude achieved the highest overall accuracy, with 45.9% of responses rated as optimal (Likert 5) and 87% as optimal/acceptable (Likert 4-5).

unlisted_practices: Converting guideline figures and tables into plain structured text before LLM evaluation
Prompt rephrasing/prompt engineering to improve response quality

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the accuracy of LLMs on urological cancer clinical guidelines and compares simple versus rephrased prompts (prompt engineering) to assess the impact on response quality.
